p1: "My grandfather watched the house in the 1920s. My father watched in the 1960s. It is now my time."
That letter was waiting for a family who had just bought a house in Westfield, New Jersey.
June 2014. They paid about 1.3 million dollars. They hadn't even moved in yet.
It was typed. And it was signed... The Watcher.
More letters came. The writer called the house "my job, my life, my obsession."
"Who am I? I am the Watcher."
The family never moved in. Not one night.
Police investigated. So did private investigators and former FBI agents.
In 2019, they sold the house for 959,000 dollars. A huge loss.
To this day, no one knows who The Watcher is... or if they're still watching.
